links.comparator_used: Fine-tuned Llama 3.2 3B without retrieval augmentation (non-RAG), site-specific models
links.outcome: Macro F1 and weighted F1 for radiological protocol classification across three Mayo Clinic sites
links.effect: RAG improved macro F1 at Arizona (Δ=0.0306, p=0.0074) and Florida (Δ=0.0245, p=0.0217) with equivalent weighted F1; at Rochester there was no macro F1 improvement and weighted F1 was significantly degraded (Δ=-0.0180, p=1.0000).
links.tradeoff: Site-specific heterogeneity, so site-specific tuning may be necessary. RAG also introduced an abstention mechanism with low baseline rates (1-2.5%).
links.quote: Paired bootstrap analyses revealed that RAG improved macro F1 at two of three sites (Arizona:: Δ =0.0306, p=0.0074; Florida: Δ =0.0245, p=0.0217) while maintaining equivalent weighted F1.
